scenes.name: intro_forest
scenes.prompt: Wide establishing shot of an ancient dark forest at night. Monk walks alone along a twisting path of giant roots, holding a small lantern; twisted trees, thick mist, glowing fireflies and shafts of moonlight.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk walks forward along the root path and raises his lantern to look into the mist.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk has walked deeper along the same path and stops with his lantern raised, looking ahead into the mist.
scenes.negative_prompt: two monks, duplicate monk, second monk, another monk, twin monk

scenes.name: intro_lost
scenes.prompt: Close-up of lost Monk's worried face lit by his lantern. He holds a torn map, with gnarled branches around him and distant warm amber light between the trees.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk lowers the map slightly and turns his head toward the distant amber light.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds the lowered map and looks toward the amber light with a hopeful expression, in the same close-up.
scenes.negative_prompt: two monks, duplicate monk, second monk, another monk, twin monk

scenes.name: intro_tavern_reveal
scenes.prompt: Monk pushes aside giant ferns and discovers a massive tavern inside a colossal hollow tree, with glowing amber windows, a smoking chimney and a carved sign shaped like a foaming mug.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk parts the ferns and takes one amazed step toward the hollow-tree tavern.
scenes.end_prompt: The ferns are fully parted and Monk stands still, staring up at the glowing tavern with his mouth open.
scenes.negative_prompt: two monks, duplicate monk, second monk, another monk, twin monk

scenes.name: intro_peek
scenes.prompt: Monk peeks through the tavern door at the band on a stage of barrels: Prima sings, Saul plays lead guitar, Rubo plays second guitar, Pedro plays bass, Axel plays drums and Patricia plays violin. Warm firelight, smoke and a cheering fantasy crowd.
scenes.motion_prompt: The door opens wider as Monk leans in and the band plays the final beat of the phrase.
scenes.end_prompt: The tavern door is half open, Monk leans in with wide eyes, and the six musicians hold an energetic final chord on stage.

scenes.name: intro_cerveza_roar
scenes.prompt: The tavern erupts in a wild cheer. Monk stands startled in the doorway while Prima and Pedro raise giant foaming mugs with the crowd, beer foam splashing under red and amber stage lights.
scenes.motion_prompt: Prima and Pedro lift their mugs with the crowd while Monk raises his hands in surprise.
scenes.end_prompt: Prima, Pedro and the crowd hold their mugs high, and Monk stands frozen in the doorway with his hands raised.

scenes.name: intro_bartender
scenes.prompt: BarTender pours golden beer from a huge oak barrel into a giant mug behind the bar, foam overflowing, while Monk watches in awe in warm amber light.
scenes.motion_prompt: BarTender finishes pouring, sets the barrel down and smiles at Monk.
scenes.end_prompt: The giant mug is full and overflowing with white foam; BarTender has set down the barrel and grins at amazed Monk.

scenes.name: intro_first_mug
scenes.prompt: Monk sits at a barrel table while BarTender slides a giant mug of golden beer toward him. Pedro sits beside Monk and raises his own mug in the cozy smoky tavern.
scenes.motion_prompt: The mug slides to Monk, who takes its handle with both hands as Pedro smiles.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds the giant mug with both hands, eyes shining, while BarTender and Pedro watch him warmly.

scenes.name: verse1_first_gulp
scenes.prompt: Close-up of Monk taking his first huge gulp from the giant mug of golden beer, with warm tavern light and cheering patrons softly visible behind him.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk lowers the mug after a gulp, revealing a foam moustache and a delighted smile.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds the lowered mug, with a thick white foam moustache and a huge delighted smile, in the same close-up.

scenes.name: verse1_hangover_magic
scenes.prompt: Close-up of Monk with a tiny dark storm cloud above his head, representing his hangover, as he takes another sip of golden beer.
scenes.motion_prompt: The little cloud dissolves into golden sparkles while Monk relaxes and smiles with relief.
scenes.end_prompt: The dark cloud has vanished into golden sparkles above Monk's head, and he smiles peacefully with his eyes closed.

scenes.name: verse1_empty_mug
scenes.prompt: Monk slams an empty mug onto a barrel table. Pedro laughs and gives him an enthusiastic friendly pat on the shoulder, with beer droplets sparkling in the air.
scenes.motion_prompt: Pedro's pat makes Monk slide a short distance along the bench, dizzy and laughing.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk sits at the end of the same bench, dizzy and laughing, while Pedro grins beside the empty mug.

scenes.name: verse1_drummer
scenes.prompt: Axel pounds the drums with energetic heavy-metal rhythm, beer splashing and sparks flying, while Monk covers his ears and laughs beside the stage.
scenes.motion_prompt: Axel lifts both drumsticks and strikes the final drum hit as Monk laughs.
scenes.end_prompt: Axel finishes a powerful drum hit with both sticks raised, and Monk laughs with his hands over his ears.

scenes.name: chorus1_table_dance
scenes.prompt: Monk, Patricia, Pedro and Prima dance on sturdy barrel tables with mugs raised, foam flying, firelight and stage lights creating a chaotic heavy-metal party.
scenes.motion_prompt: The four friends jump and land in a synchronized dance pose with their mugs raised.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk, Patricia, Pedro and Prima hold a joyful dance pose on the tables, mugs raised and foam suspended in the air.

scenes.name: chorus1_blonde_beer
scenes.prompt: Extreme close-up of golden blonde beer pouring from a wooden tap into a frosty mug held by BarTender, bubbles rising and white foam glistening in warm backlight.
scenes.motion_prompt: The mug fills and BarTender moves it away from the tap without spilling the foam crown.
scenes.end_prompt: BarTender holds the full frosty mug away from the tap, topped with golden blonde beer and a thick white foam crown.

scenes.name: chorus1_wheat_beer
scenes.prompt: A tall pint of cloudy wheat beer stands on a barrel table. Behind it Saul plays lead guitar and Patricia plays violin, while Monk headbangs gently in the foreground.
scenes.motion_prompt: Saul and Patricia finish a phrase together while Monk lowers his head in a headbanging pose.
scenes.end_prompt: Saul and Patricia hold the final note behind the wheat beer, and Monk is caught mid-headbang in the foreground.

scenes.name: chorus1_dark_beer
scenes.prompt: Close-up of a dark stout with almost no foam in a heavy mug. Monk studies it doubtfully while Pedro watches with an encouraging smile.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk takes a cautious sip and his doubtful expression turns into pleasant surprise.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk lowers the stout mug and smiles in pleasant surprise while Pedro nods approvingly.

scenes.name: chorus1_toast
scenes.prompt: Monk, Patricia, Pedro and Prima gather in a close group toast beneath hanging lanterns, each holding a giant mug near the center of the group.
scenes.motion_prompt: The four mugs move together and clink, sending a small wave of white foam upward.
scenes.end_prompt: The four mugs meet in the center and a wave of white foam bursts upward toward the hanging lanterns.

scenes.name: verse2_moshpit
scenes.prompt: A wild but friendly tavern mosh pit surrounds Monk, who begins crowd-surfing. Axel, Pedro and Prima headbang at the edge and help support him, with mugs held safely high.
scenes.motion_prompt: The crowd lifts Monk higher while Axel, Pedro and Prima steady him and cheer.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk is lifted above the crowd with his arms spread and a big smile, supported near Axel, Pedro and Prima.

scenes.name: verse2_whiskey
scenes.prompt: Monk stands nervously at the bar with BarTender. A dusty bottle of dark liquor with a red wax seal, a shot glass and a pint of beer sit between them.
scenes.motion_prompt: BarTender fills the shot glass and slides it toward hesitant Monk.
scenes.end_prompt: The filled shot glass rests in front of Monk, who reaches for it hesitantly while BarTender grins.

scenes.name: verse2_shot
scenes.prompt: Monk holds a shot of dark liquor at the bar while BarTender and the patrons watch expectantly, mugs in hand.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk downs the shot and reacts with an exaggerated grimace as harmless cartoon steam rises around his ears.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds the empty shot glass with a comic grimace and red cheeks while BarTender laughs and slaps the bar.

scenes.name: bridge_lonely_druid
scenes.prompt: Druid sits alone by the tavern door in the rain, looking tired and sad. Monk notices him from inside and waves him toward the warm amber doorway.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk opens the door wider and beckons while Druid looks up with hope.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk stands in the open doorway waving Druid inside, and Druid looks up hopefully from the rain.

scenes.name: bridge_invitation
scenes.prompt: Inside the warm tavern, Monk welcomes Druid with a hand on his shoulder and offers him a large mug of golden blonde beer.
scenes.motion_prompt: Druid accepts the mug with both hands and his sad expression becomes a warm smile.
scenes.end_prompt: Druid holds the mug with both hands and smiles, with Monk's welcoming hand on his shoulder.

scenes.name: bridge_singalong
scenes.prompt: Monk, Druid, Patricia, Pedro and Rubo sing together with arms around each other's shoulders and mugs raised, surrounded by the warm glowing tavern crowd.
scenes.motion_prompt: The group sways together to one side and raises their mugs as they sing.
scenes.end_prompt: The five friends lean into one shared singing pose, arms on shoulders and mugs raised, all smiling.

scenes.name: chorus2_recipe_scroll
scenes.prompt: BarTender unrolls an ancient scroll covered in pictograms of barley, hops, water, yeast and a foaming mug. Monk and Druid lean in eagerly while Saul studies the recipe, all lit by candles.
scenes.motion_prompt: BarTender unrolls the last part of the scroll and Druid points to the hop pictograms.
scenes.end_prompt: The scroll lies fully unrolled on the bar; Monk, BarTender, Druid and Saul lean over its pictograms in candlelight.

scenes.name: chorus2_cauldron
scenes.prompt: Monk stirs a giant brewing cauldron with a wooden oar. Druid adds herbs and Prima pours in barley, with steam and golden sparks rising in the root-and-copper tavern kitchen.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk lifts the oar slightly as Druid and Prima finish adding their ingredients and the cauldron bubbles.
scenes.end_prompt: The cauldron bubbles with a golden glow, Monk holds the steaming oar above it, and Druid and Prima admire the brew.

scenes.name: chorus2_ingredients
scenes.prompt: Druid and Prima toss hops and barley into the glowing cauldron while Monk watches in wonder, herbs and sparks floating around the same kitchen.
scenes.motion_prompt: A warm burst of amber magical light rises from the cauldron and Monk shields his amazed face with one hand.
scenes.end_prompt: Amber and gold light fills the kitchen; Monk shields his face with one hand while Druid and Prima smile beside the cauldron.

scenes.name: chorus2_taps
scenes.prompt: The tavern's wooden beer taps fill mugs on a whimsical conveyor of roots and wooden gears. Monk, BarTender, Prima and Saul watch the first mugs fill with golden beer.
scenes.motion_prompt: The conveyor advances, the last mugs fill and the four friends raise their arms in celebration.
scenes.end_prompt: A row of full mugs lines the conveyor, white foam spills gently onto the floor, and Monk, BarTender, Prima and Saul cheer.

scenes.name: chorus2_recipe_relic
scenes.prompt: Monk holds the ancient recipe scroll aloft like a sacred relic while Druid and BarTender stand proudly beside him near a fountain of toasted amber beer.
scenes.motion_prompt: Druid and BarTender help lift Monk slightly as the crowd cheers and Monk raises the scroll higher.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds the scroll high above his head, supported by Druid and BarTender, in a triumphant low-angle pose.

scenes.name: verse3_spotlight
scenes.prompt: Prima lowers her microphone as the band pauses. Patricia gestures toward nervous Monk, who holds the recipe scroll while a spotlight settles on him.
scenes.motion_prompt: Prima offers the microphone toward Monk and Patricia encourages him with a small gesture.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk stands in the spotlight clutching the scroll, while Prima offers the microphone and Patricia smiles encouragingly.

scenes.name: verse3_lesson
scenes.prompt: Monk reads the recipe with dramatic gestures. Druid and Saul listen intently in the front row, comparing it with their notes, with a wall of beer taps behind them.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk raises one finger to emphasize the final instruction while Druid and Saul lean forward.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk holds one finger up above the open scroll, and Druid and Saul lean forward attentively with their notes.

scenes.name: verse3_all_beers
scenes.prompt: Monk points toward a display of golden blonde, toasted amber and black stout beers. Druid, Saul and Pedro stand beside him with mugs at chest height.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk raises his pointing hand and the other three lift their mugs toward the display.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk points upward while Druid, Saul and Pedro hold their different beers high in a joyful toast.

scenes.name: bridge2_toast
scenes.prompt: Monk, Patricia, Pedro and Saul join a huge tavern toast around the center of the room as a golden beer geyser begins to rise nearby.
scenes.motion_prompt: Their mugs clink and the golden geyser rises while all four recoil slightly with delighted smiles.
scenes.end_prompt: A golden beer geyser rises high behind Monk, Patricia, Pedro and Saul, who cheer with their mugs held together.

scenes.name: bridge2_foam_face
scenes.prompt: The golden beer geyser begins forming a giant friendly face of white foam above Monk and Patricia, who stare upward in awe.
scenes.motion_prompt: The foam face finishes forming and smiles while Monk and Patricia throw their arms up and cheer.
scenes.end_prompt: A giant smiling face of white foam floats above Monk and Patricia, who cheer with their arms raised.

scenes.name: chorus3_band
scenes.prompt: Full band performance on the barrel stage: Prima sings, Saul plays lead guitar, Rubo plays second guitar, Pedro plays bass, Axel plays drums and Patricia plays violin, with smoke, sparks and warm stage lights.
scenes.motion_prompt: The six musicians play through the final phrase and finish together on one powerful chord.
scenes.end_prompt: Prima, Saul, Rubo, Pedro, Axel and Patricia hold the final chord together in a cohesive wide stage shot.

scenes.name: chorus3_air_guitar
scenes.prompt: Monk, still wearing his usual brown monastic habit, playfully uses a broom as an air guitar. Axel faces him in a friendly air-guitar duel while the crowd headbangs.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk drops carefully to his knees in a rock pose with the broom while Axel raises his imaginary guitar.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk kneels in a comic rock pose holding the broom like a guitar, and Axel celebrates opposite him.

scenes.name: chorus3_fretboard
scenes.prompt: Close-up of Saul's hands playing the fretboard of his lead guitar, with Rubo playing second guitar beside him and Monk's amazed face visible in the foreground.
scenes.motion_prompt: Saul bends one sustained note while Rubo holds the rhythm and Monk watches with widening eyes.
scenes.end_prompt: Saul holds a high note on the fretboard, Rubo sustains the rhythm beside him, and Monk stares in amazement.

scenes.name: chorus3_jig
scenes.prompt: Pedro and Prima dance a wild jig in a tavern circle while Monk tries to copy their steps beside an open barrel of white beer foam.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk misses one dance step and tumbles safely into the soft foam barrel as Pedro and Prima laugh.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk sits inside the barrel covered in white foam, laughing, while Pedro and Prima finish their jig beside him.

scenes.name: chorus3_foam_god
scenes.prompt: Monk begins rising from the barrel of white beer foam with a mug in each hand, still in his brown habit, while Pedro and Prima cheer beside him.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk stands tall and raises both mugs as the foam settles into a playful crown on his head.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk stands in the barrel with both mugs raised and a crown of white foam, while Pedro and Prima cheer.

scenes.name: solo_guitar
scenes.prompt: Guitar solo: Saul leans back playing lead guitar while Rubo drives the rhythm on second guitar, with tree-stump amps, sparks and stage smoke behind them.
scenes.motion_prompt: Saul leans into the final high note and Rubo strikes the last rhythmic chord as sparks rise.
scenes.end_prompt: Saul holds his lead guitar high at the end of the solo and Rubo holds the final chord beside him under the stage lights.

scenes.name: solo_drums
scenes.prompt: Axel plays an energetic drum solo while Monk pounds a small barrel beside the stage in rhythm, with the crowd cheering around them.
scenes.motion_prompt: Axel raises both sticks for a crash and Monk lands one final playful hit on his barrel.
scenes.end_prompt: Axel strikes the crash with both sticks raised and Monk freezes after his final barrel hit, both grinning.

scenes.name: solo_crowd_surf
scenes.prompt: Monk balances on a small beer barrel carried by the friendly crowd. Pedro, Prima and Rubo reach up to steady the barrel as foam and sparks fill the air.
scenes.motion_prompt: The crowd carries the barrel forward while Monk spreads his arms and the three friends keep it stable.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk balances confidently on the barrel above the crowd with arms spread, supported near Pedro, Prima and Rubo.

scenes.name: solo_roof_off
scenes.prompt: A magical burst of foam and sparks begins lifting the tavern roof above Monk, Prima, Saul and Axel, with the full moon appearing through the opening.
scenes.motion_prompt: The roof panels lift away magically and the four friends raise their arms toward the revealed full moon.
scenes.end_prompt: The roof is open to the full moon, and Monk, Prima, Saul and Axel cheer with their arms raised beneath it.

scenes.name: solo_stage_dive
scenes.prompt: Monk prepares a playful stage dive at the edge of the low stage while Prima and Pedro wait with the crowd to catch him safely.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk makes a short stage dive and Prima, Pedro and the crowd catch and lift him.
scenes.end_prompt: Prima, Pedro and the crowd hold Monk safely aloft, all grinning amid slow-motion foam and sparks.

scenes.name: solo_beer_waterfall
scenes.prompt: BarTender pours a comically large waterfall of golden beer from a giant barrel into an enormous mug, with white foam waves and absurd fantasy scale.
scenes.motion_prompt: The last golden beer pours into the giant mug and BarTender lowers the empty barrel proudly.
scenes.end_prompt: The enormous mug is full of golden beer and white foam, and BarTender holds the lowered empty barrel with a proud smile.

scenes.name: solo_tavern_wide
scenes.prompt: Wide characterless shot of the colossal hollow-tree tavern glowing in the dark forest, fireflies swirling and the full moon above while music shakes the trees.
scenes.motion_prompt: The trees sway gently with the music and fireflies spiral around the glowing tavern windows.
scenes.end_prompt: The hollow-tree tavern glows brightly, surrounding trees lean with the rhythm and fireflies swirl beneath the full moon.

scenes.name: final_chorus_goodbye
scenes.prompt: At dawn, Monk steps through the tavern door with a small barrel under one arm and the recipe scroll in the other. BarTender and Druid stand at the doorway to say goodbye.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk steps outside, turns back and waves while BarTender and Druid return the wave.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk stands just outside holding the barrel and scroll, waving goodbye to BarTender and Druid in the warm doorway.

scenes.name: final_chorus_journey_home
scenes.prompt: Monk walks confidently back through the misty morning forest, holding a glowing mug of amber beer instead of a lantern, with the distant tavern behind him.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk walks farther along the same path as fireflies guide him and the tavern recedes into the distance.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk continues down the misty path with the glowing mug, the tavern door now small and warm far behind him.

scenes.name: final_chorus_monastery
scenes.prompt: Monk arrives at a small stone monastery courtyard carrying the barrel and glowing recipe scroll. A few distinct fellow monks gather curiously around him in morning light.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk sets down the barrel and opens the scroll while the other monks lean closer with curiosity.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk smiles proudly beside the barrel and open scroll as the distinct fellow monks gather around to look.

scenes.name: final_chorus_sharing
scenes.prompt: Monk pours golden beer for his fellow monks in the monastery courtyard. Druid, Rubo and Saul watch proudly from the forest edge with their own mugs, in warm sunrise light.
scenes.motion_prompt: Monk finishes pouring and raises his mug with the group while Druid, Rubo and Saul join the toast from nearby.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk and the fellow monks raise full mugs together, while Druid, Rubo and Saul smile and lift theirs at the forest edge.

scenes.name: outro_title
scenes.prompt: Final group portrait on a hill under a giant full moon: Monk in his unchanged brown habit raises a mug with Axel, BarTender, Druid, Patricia, Pedro, Prima, Rubo and Saul, surrounded by foam and fireflies.
scenes.motion_prompt: All nine friends lift their mugs together into one final heroic toast as fireflies spiral upward.
scenes.end_prompt: Monk, Axel, BarTender, Druid, Patricia, Pedro, Prima, Rubo and Saul hold their mugs high together against the giant full moon.
